items.title: Section 45
items.description: The Incontestability Clause: No policy can be called into question on grounds of misstatement or fraud after 3 years from issuance.

items.title: MWP Act 1874 (Section 6)
items.description: Married Women's Property Act ensures that the policy benefits are strictly protected for the wife/children and cannot be attached by creditors.
